stemMd: Which sample contains the greatest number of molecules? Use molar masses H2 = 2, O2 = 32, CO2 = 44 and H2O = 18 g/mol.
explanationMd: Compare moles, not masses. Four grams of hydrogen is 4/2 = 2 mol; the other samples contain one mole or half a mole. Molecule count is proportional to mole count.

distractorRationale.e: This is only half a mole.
distractorRationale.c: This is one mole, fewer than two.
distractorRationale.d: This is one mole, fewer than two.
distractorRationale.b: This is one mole, fewer than two.
